access_requirement: Run a no-label Hugging Face license/access smoke before any collection.
alias_hygiene: drop empty normalized aliases; deduplicate aliases; never use raw substring containment for the primary label; freeze the normalized alias list per item
broad_model_family_note: Gemma-2B development artifacts exist; novelty comes primarily from the unopened PopQA dataset family and secondarily from Gemma-3/this checkpoint.
collection_gate: Pin the official PopQA artifact and resolved primary and fallback revisions; pass the primary checkpoint access smoke; run a 20-row telemetry smoke, then a deterministic 200-row scientific pilot without opening detector AUROC. Full collection only if mixed-v2 telemetry is complete and both alias-correctness classes contain at least 30 responses.
dataset: PopQA official 14k open-domain factual QA release
generation: one greedy response per prompt; max_new_tokens=150
primary_label: Unicode-NFKC lowercase, punctuation-to-space and whitespace-collapse; correct iff a normalized possible_answer occurs as a complete contiguous token sequence bounded by string edges or whitespace
reuse_policy: No rank, component, sign, trust, feature, alias rule, or method selection may use these labels.

sealed_access_fallback.scientific_scope: PopQA remains an unseen dataset-family confirmation; the fallback does not support a new-model-family claim
sealed_access_fallback.when_used: only if google/gemma-3-4b-it access is unavailable before any PopQA response or correctness label is collected

secondary_label_diagnostic: official PopQA substring-membership convention, reported separately and never used for method selection

supersedes_weak_boundary.reason: new exact response cell but not a new dataset or model family; retained only as an optional same-family transfer diagnostic
